name: math_winding_number

phase_0.boundary_condition: the complex plane punctured at the origin

VINIT.justification: the singularity that defines the topological hole before any path exists

TANCH.justification: the closed set of all paths equivalent to the final integer count

AFWD.justification: positive orientation increasing the cumulative angle

AREV.justification: negative orientation decreasing the cumulative angle

CLINK.justification: joining line segments to form a continuous curve

IMSCRIB.justification: the requirement that the terminal point equals the initial point

FSPLIT.justification: splitting the path into a full rotation versus a non-enclosing arc

FFUSE.justification: recombining all angular segments into the total net change

EVALT.justification: the path successfully encircles the singularity

EVALF.justification: the path fails to encircle the singularity

ENGAGR.justification: the path passes through the singularity rendering the number undefined

IFIX.justification: the final immutable winding number recorded in the topological state

steps.domain_action: establish the punctured plane at the origin
define the starting point of the curve
initiate counter-clockwise movement along the arc
append subsequent infinitesimal segments to the path
evaluate if the current segment completes a rotation
confirm the path has crossed the positive real axis from below
merge the rotation count back into the path state
evaluate if the path reverses direction
merge the decrement back into the path state
verify the path has returned to the starting point
record the final net integer as the winding number
seal the homotopy class of the curve

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the winding number is a discrete topological invariant conserved under continuous deformation
